'''Raspar Six''' was a [[Sullustan]] depot manager who oversaw a refueling depot<ref name="DBPantora">{{Databank|pantora|Pantora}}</ref> located in [[Ro Station]] on the [[moon]] [[Pantora]]. Not long after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Six's [[hangar]] was visited by a [[Clone Force 99|renegade group]] of [[clone commando]]s and their companion, a [[Youngling|young]] genetically unaltered [[Cloning|clone]] known as [[Omega]]. Recognizing the outlaws' [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|wanted ship]], Six contacted the [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] and informed her of the girl's location. Shand, however, was ultimately unsuccessful in [[Hunting|capturing]] her [[bounty]], and the Sullustan failed to prevent the clones from leaving Pantora. Six expected punishment from the bounty hunter, but to his surprise she instead paid him a modest amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for his work and instructed him to contact her in the event the runaways resurfaced.<ref name="Cornered" />
